scope: camera/JSON vehicle alignment calibration only; no phase inference or lamp timing used
manual_video_feature: one consistently defined vehicle image point, with explicit visibility and pixel uncertainty; independent of trajectory coordinates
source_feature: raw centroid in supplied coordinate space; units UNKNOWN, empirical image registration only
clock_model: JSON timestamp = 2025-02-27T09:59:55+05:00 + media PTS + delta; delta bounded [-5,5]s; filename ignored
image_model: one planar homography, empirical approximation; tall vehicle/centroid geometry may violate it
fit_budget: one scipy least_squares invocation, max_nfev1000, no restarts or parameter grid; failed fit remains diagnostic
heldout_policy: freeze training fit before scoring all five trolleybus points; no refit from validation
acceptance: report residuals and identifiability, no calibrated subsecond sync claim from a small image-point fit; reject if outside declared 30px training /50px heldout localization allowance, limit-active or rank deficient
